rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P revised outlook to negative reflecting weakening operating performance and margin compression amid competitive pressure on the South Shore market.
rating_actions_in_window._note: Date approximated from Becker's June 15 2018 rating-action roundup that included South Shore.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's revised outlook to negative reflecting underperformance to budget through 1H FY19 and projected liquidity decline due to cash-financed capex and several system entities including the hospital missing budget.

outcome_class_rationale: South Shore weathered the 2017-2019 window with no outright downgrade but with two negative-outlook revisions (S&P 2018, Moody's 2019). Underperformance vs budget and projected liquidity decline drove the deterioration. Fitch BBB+ stable was retained.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Revenue ~$580M anchored to Fitch March 2016 press release. FY16 margin and DCOH approximated from CHIA hospital profile patterns; not all line items extracted from audited financials.

_research_notes: South Shore Hospital remained an independent regional system through window; Steward partnership / academic affiliations developed later. No major M&A 2017-2018.
